p = 'tmp/ref.py'
s = open(p).read()
s = s.replace("""def phi_value(e, occs, assign):
    u, v = e
    total = 0
    for (p, w, i) in occs:""", """def phi_value(e, occ_list, assign):
    u, v = e
    total = 0
    for (p, w, i) in occ_list:""")

import json, math
a = json.load(open('tmp/ref_core.json'))
b = json.load(open('examples/core.expected.json'))
def eq(x, y):
    if isinstance(x, dict): return x.keys()==y.keys() and all(eq(v,y[k]) for k,v in x.items())
    if isinstance(x, list): return len(x)==len(y) and all(eq(i,j) for i,j in zip(x,y))
    if isinstance(x, float): return abs(x-y) <= 1e-9
    return x == y
print('ref matches core expected:', eq(a,b))
EOF
